input.query: SELECT platform, version, release_date FROM stg_app_releases WHERE release_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-01' AND DATE '2025-12-15' ORDER BY release_date, platform

WITH x AS (SELECT CASE WHEN decision_date < DATE '2025-11-13' THEN 'before' ELSE 'after' END AS period, platform, doc_type, SUM(n_approved) approved, SUM(n_decisions) decisions FROM agg_kyc_daily WHERE decision_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-01' AND DATE '2025-12-15' GROUP BY 1,2,3) SELECT period, platform, doc_type, approved, decisions, approved::DOUBLE/decisions AS rate FROM x WHERE platform='android' AND doc_type='national_id' ORDER BY period
